title: Implement dynamic cumulative Total Completed tracking and optional batch dispatch entry

requirements.summary: Update DailyProductionReportForm to make Total Completed a read-only calculated field that fetches cumulative totals from the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Total Completed field is displayed as read-only in the form
Total Completed value is automatically calculated as: (sum of all previous today_production values for this operation) + (current today_production value)
The calculation fetches data from the backend database for the selected operation
Total Completed updates automatically when today_production value changes

file_operations.description: Convert the Total Completed field from an editable input to a read-only display field. Add logic to fetch all daily production reports for the selected operation using the useGetAllDailyProductionReports hook, filter by operation ID, sum their todayProduction values, and add the current today_production input value to calculate the cumulative total. Update the calculation whenever the selected operation or today_production value changes. Remove any state management for totalCompleted input and replace with computed value display.

requirements.summary: Update DailyProductionReportForm to automatically calculate and display In Hand as a read-only computed value
acceptanceCriteria: In Hand field is displayed as read-only
In Hand is calculated as: Total Completed - Despatch
Value updates automatically when Total Completed or Despatch changes
Display shows 0 or positive values only

file_operations.description: Convert the In Hand field from an editable input to a read-only computed field. Implement automatic calculation using the formula: In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch. Ensure the calculation updates reactively whenever either Total Completed (from REQ-54 calculation) or the Despatch input value changes. Display the result as a formatted number with minimum value of 0 (no negative values). Remove any manual input handling for the inHand field and replace with computed value display.

requirements.summary: Add optional Batch Dispatch Entry field at the top of DailyProductionReportForm to auto-populate Despatch for all operations
acceptanceCriteria: Batch Dispatch Entry field appears at the top of the form above individual operation entries
Field is labeled clearly as 'Apply Same Dispatch to All Operations' or similar
When a value is entered, all 17 operation Despatch fields are automatically filled with that value
Field is optional and can be left empty for individual dispatch entry
Clearing the batch field does not clear individual Despatch values already entered

file_operations.description: Add a new optional numeric input field at the top of the form, above the individual operation entries section, labeled 'Apply Same Dispatch to All Operations (Optional)'. Implement state management for this batch dispatch value. When a value is entered in this field, automatically populate the Despatch field for all 17 operations with the same value by updating the despatched state for each operation. Ensure the field is clearly marked as optional. Implement logic so that clearing the batch field does not reset individual Despatch values that were already set. Position the field prominently with helper text explaining its purpose.

requirements.summary: Update ContainerDailyReportPage to display calculated In Hand values using the formula: In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch
acceptanceCriteria: In Hand column displays calculated values (Total Completed - Despatch) for each operation
Calculation is performed on the frontend after fetching data
All 17 operations show correct calculated In Hand values
Zero or empty records display 0 for In Hand calculation

file_operations.description: Update the table rendering logic to compute In Hand values dynamically for each operation row. After fetching daily production reports from the backend, calculate In Hand using the formula: In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch for each operation. Ensure the calculation handles missing or zero values gracefully by defaulting to 0. Display the calculated In Hand value in the appropriate column for all 17 operations. Remove any reliance on the inHand field from the backend data and use the computed value instead.
